verified: NVIDIA's own announcement states the GPU is part of the Vera Rubin platform, has more than 50,000 CUDA cores, includes sparse data acceleration and seventh-generation NVLink, and is targeted at HPC and analytics workloads, with availability expected in 2028.
unconfirmed: the "record number of CUDA cores" claim (no comparison part is given), any performance gain from the sparse data acceleration or the balanced compute/memory design, and all specifications beyond core count — memory size, bandwidth, power draw, form factor and price — plus any independent benchmark; NVIDIA provided no measured results.

verified: 英伟达官方博客称 Rubin HPC 属于 Vera Rubin 平台、在 SC26 发布、单 GPU CUDA 核心数超过 5 万个、具备稀疏数据加速与第七代 NVLink，并写明预计 2028 年上市。
unconfirmed: 相比上一代产品的实际性能提升幅度、价格、完整规格与功耗，均无数据；所有性能表述都来自英伟达自己的说法，没有独立测试或客户实测。

titles.en: NVIDIA Announces Rubin HPC GPU for Scientific Simulation
titles.zh: 英伟达发布 Rubin HPC GPU：逾 5 万 CUDA 核心，预计 2028 年上市
